articles.title: Israel to close occupied West Bank crossings over election
articles.summary: Israel to close occupied West Bank crossings over election Israel will close all land crossings into and out of the occupied West Bank on Tuesday for its general election, the Israeli army said. The announcement came a day after Israeli forces imposed a lockdown in Hebron and forcibly evicted thousands of Palestinians from their homes.
